title: Testing the Cafe Menu  (测试咖啡馆菜单)

segments.t: 周日晚些时候在咖啡角，Tessa把用来试吃的小碗和两份果挞放在Caleb和Owen兄弟俩面前。请先完整听一遍这段场景。
Every good neighborhood cafe needs one hot lunch bowl and one signature cake.
Did we just get promoted to official taste testers, Caleb?
Best job in the building! Which bowl do we try first, Tessa?
Left spoon: roasted tomato soup with fresh courtyard herbs.
Rich, warm, and great with crusty bread on a rainy afternoon!
Right spoon: golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil, even better!
Now try the two lemon tart slices: thin pastry on the left, almond crust on the right.
Oh, the almond crust with Saturday market lemon is unbeatable!
Save one slice for Graham, Tessa, or he will lock us out of the kitchen!
So Wednesday's menu is set: golden lentil soup, warm bread, almond lemon tart, and tea!
Simple, honest, and easy to serve quickly from noon to evening.
Now let us hope for sunny skies tomorrow so our shutter paint dries!
现在我们来逐句讲解这场试吃。
Every good neighborhood cafe needs one hot lunch bowl and one signature cake.
‘每个好的街区咖啡馆都需要一道热汤作为午餐和一款招牌糕点。’当一道菜是代表这家店的特色时，signature 这个词在这里作为形容词
signature cake.
就像带上了创作者的签名一样。
Did we just get promoted to official taste testers, Caleb?
‘我们是不是刚被提拔成了官方试吃员，Caleb？’在日常口语中，用 get 构成的被动语态非常生动地传达了刚刚发生的变化：
get promoted to
后面跟着 official taste testers 这个有趣的头衔。
Best job in the building! Which bowl do we try first, Tessa?
‘这栋楼里最棒的工作！我们先试哪个碗，Tessa？’当桌面上提供两个选项时，选择会用 Which 来提问，即
Which bowl do we try first,
使用一般现在时来请求即时的指示。
Left spoon: roasted tomato soup with fresh courtyard herbs.
‘左边的勺子：烤番茄汤配院子里的新鲜香草。’在烤箱里烤制蔬菜或肉类以浓缩其风味，用分词表示
roasted tomato soup
来自于动词 roast。
Rich, warm, and great with crusty bread on a rainy afternoon!
‘美味，热气腾腾的，在下雨的下午配上脆皮面包简直太棒了！’从名词 crust（外壳）加上 -y 就变成了完美的烘焙形容词：
crusty bread
新鲜出炉的。
Right spoon: golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil, even better!
‘右边的勺子：金黄扁豆汤配柠檬和橄榄油，甚至更好！’当第一选择已经很好，为了强调比较级，可以在前面加上 even，如
even better!
为扁豆汤锦上添花。
Now try the two lemon tart slices: thin pastry on the left, almond crust on the right.
‘现在尝尝这两份柠檬果挞：左边是薄面皮，右边是杏仁挞底。’从馅饼或蛋糕上切下来的每一个三角形部分称为 slice，例如
lemon tart slices:
这里将薄面皮 (thin pastry) 与杏仁挞底 (almond crust) 进行了比较。
Oh, the almond crust with Saturday market lemon is unbeatable!
‘哦，杏仁挞底配上周六市场的柠檬简直是绝配，无与伦比！’在动词 beat（击败，胜过）的基础上加上前缀 un- 和后缀 -able，组成了
unbeatable!
这是对一道菜谱最高的赞誉。
Save one slice for Graham, Tessa, or he will lock us out of the kitchen!
‘给 Graham 留一份，Tessa，不然他会把我们锁在厨房门外！’把某人锁在门外，是由 lock 与 out of 结合而成的：
lock us out of the kitchen!
这与 lock in 的意思相反。
So Wednesday's menu is set: golden lentil soup, warm bread, almond lemon tart, and tea!
‘那么周三的菜单就定下来了：金黄扁豆汤、温热的面包、杏仁柠檬果挞，还有茶！’为了宣布某个计划或菜单已经决定并敲定，用三个字母就足够了，即
is set:
直接而果断。
Simple, honest, and easy to serve quickly from noon to evening.
‘简单，真诚，从中午到晚上都能快速上菜。’在像 easy、hard 或 ready 这样的形容词之后，会使用带 to 的主动不定式：
easy to serve quickly
而 from noon to evening 涵盖了整个下午和晚上的时间段。
Now let us hope for sunny skies tomorrow so our shutter paint dries!
‘现在让我们祈祷明天是个晴天，这样我们的百叶窗油漆就能干了！’当我们希望好天气或某个具体消息到来时，hope 后面会紧跟 for 加上名词：
hope for sunny skies
为午夜意想不到的转折做了铺垫。让我们再把这段场景连起来听一遍。
Every good neighborhood cafe needs one hot lunch bowl and one signature cake.
Did we just get promoted to official taste testers, Caleb?
Best job in the building! Which bowl do we try first, Tessa?
Left spoon: roasted tomato soup with fresh courtyard herbs.
Rich, warm, and great with crusty bread on a rainy afternoon!
Right spoon: golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil, even better!
Now try the two lemon tart slices: thin pastry on the left, almond crust on the right.
Oh, the almond crust with Saturday market lemon is unbeatable!
Save one slice for Graham, Tessa, or he will lock us out of the kitchen!
So Wednesday's menu is set: golden lentil soup, warm bread, almond lemon tart, and tea!
Simple, honest, and easy to serve quickly from noon to evening.
Now let us hope for sunny skies tomorrow so our shutter paint dries!
金黄扁豆汤和杏仁挞底柠檬果挞全票胜出。现在让我们进入这一集的第八个也是最后一个场景，时间是在午夜前夕。
See you tomorrow!
